title: Removal of pharmaceutical residues from aquatic systems using bimetallic metal–organic frameworks (BMOFs): a critical review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20168-20182
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03056K, Review Article

Pharmaceutical pollution is an increasing environmental concern, and this review examines the use of bimetallic metal–organic frameworks (BMOFs) to remove pharmaceutical contaminants from aquatic ecosystems.
